title: MOTTO: A Mixture-of-Experts Framework for Multi-Treatment, Multi-Outcome Treatment Effect Estimation

problem.claim: The paper addresses multi-treatment, multi-outcome treatment effect estimation.

gap.claim: Existing methods struggle to address complex interplays and ensure robust counterfactual balancing across treatment-outcome pairs simultaneously.

narrative_sequence.summary: Multi-treatment, multi-outcome treatment effect estimation is important for industry-level applications.
Social media advertising involves deploying multiple interventions while tracking multiple metrics.
Existing methods have difficulty handling treatment-outcome interplays and robust counterfactual balancing.
